Paint protection film, or PPF, is a transparent protective film applied to painted exterior surfaces. It forms a replaceable barrier over the original paint to help reduce damage from small stone impacts, road debris and minor surface abrasion. Coverage matters: only the filmed areas receive that barrier. PPF does not repair existing chips or make a car damage-proof. Paint condition, the selected film and installation scope determine the result. Partial or selected-panel coverage focuses the work on priority areas and leaves the remaining paint without film. Sand and dust also accumulate between washes, and rubbing a dry surface can create abrasion. PPF can help reduce some of that wear on covered paint. Intense sun and heat make product selection and care relevant too. UV, staining and heat-related properties vary by film; ask for the selected product’s guidance. Careful washing remains essential, especially for high-value cars whose original paint you want to preserve. Appearance & film choice Choosing Your PPF Film & Finish Clear paint protection film is intended to preserve the underlying paint’s appearance. The film’s texture, edges and joins may still be visible, especially on complex panels or where only part of a panel is covered. From paint assessment to handover Our PPF Installation Process The vehicle’s condition and selected film determine the preparation and installation method. Previous repairs or paint defects may affect preparation and suitability. 0 2 Agree the scope Confirm the chosen film, covered panels, preparation, cutting method and edge treatment in the quotation before work begins. 0 3 Prepare and install Washing, decontamination and any agreed correction prepare the paint before film is fitted. Ask for product-specific washing, maintenance and warranty information at handover. Review the work behind the quote Choosing Paint Protection Film Installers Compare installation scope as well as film choice. Ask to see work on similar panel shapes and inspect edges, joins and the finish under good lighting. Discuss visible boundaries before choosing partial-panel coverage. Share any repainting, previous film or existing damage during the assessment. Ask how the installer will prepare those areas and whether correction or repair is needed first. A useful quote identifies the film, covered panels, exclusions, cutting method and aftercare. Confirm any written product or installation warranty terms separately; the word “PPF” alone does not specify them. After installation PPF Care, Lifespan & Removal Maintain the film as well as the paint Follow the chosen film’s first-wash interval and approved cleaning guidance. Remove dust gently, avoid dry rubbing and keep pressure-washer jets away from edges. Driving, parking exposure, film choice and care all influence service life; there is no single replacement schedule for every car. When the film needs attention Have lifting edges, persistent staining, cuts or damaged areas assessed. Do not assume an aged or damaged film can be restored by polishing or that a mark has only affected the film. An inspection helps establish whether the affected coverage needs replacement and whether the paint underneath needs work. Can PPF be removed? Yes. Professional removal should follow the film manufacturer’s guidance. Tell the workshop about previous repainting or repairs before a removal method is agreed. The existing film and paint condition need assessment; removal should not be promised as risk-free. No name or phone number is needed here. Privacy policy Please use the WhatsApp or call links on this page to request your quote. Before you decide PPF Questions, Answered What is PPF for cars? Paint protection film (PPF) is a transparent protective film applied to painted exterior surfaces. It creates a replaceable physical layer that can reduce stone-chip damage and minor surface abrasion on the panels it covers. How much does PPF cost in Dubai? PPF cost depends on the car’s size and shape, covered panels, chosen film and finish, paint preparation and installation complexity. Send DIGI-TEC your brand, model, year and coverage preference for a vehicle-specific quotation. There is no single price for every car. Is PPF worth it in Dubai? PPF can be useful when preserving paint is a priority, particularly for frequent highway driving or high-value vehicles. Consider the panels exposed to road debris, your budget and how you maintain the car. Film reduces some surface damage but does not make paint damage-proof. How long does PPF last? Service life varies with the selected film, installation, exposure and care. Ask for the product’s rated lifespan, maintenance requirements and any written warranty terms in your quote. DIGI-TEC does not state a universal lifespan for all films. Does PPF protect against scratches? PPF can reduce minor abrasion on covered areas, but it is not scratch-proof. Cuts, deep scratches and impacts may damage the film or the paint underneath. Have persistent marks assessed rather than attempting abrasive polishing or assuming every mark can be removed. Does PPF protect against stone chips? PPF provides a physical barrier that can reduce paint damage from small stone impacts on covered panels. It cannot prevent every chip: impact energy, film properties and the point of contact all matter. Does PPF protect against sand? Film can help reduce light abrasion on covered paint, but it is not sand-proof. Dust and grit still need careful removal. Avoid rubbing a dry, dusty surface and follow the film manufacturer’s washing guidance. Can PPF be applied to a new car? Yes, subject to inspection of the paint and the chosen film’s requirements. New paint can still have contamination or defects, so its condition should be checked before coverage and preparation are agreed. Can PPF be installed on a used car? Often, yes. Existing chips, scratches, previous repairs and repainted panels need assessment first. PPF does not repair damaged paint, and any necessary correction or refinishing should be discussed before installation. What is the difference between PPF and ceramic coating? PPF is a physical film that can reduce stone-chip damage and minor abrasion. Ceramic coating is a surface treatment that can improve water behaviour, cleaning and appearance depending on the product. Coating does not provide the same stone-chip barrier as film. Can ceramic coating be applied over PPF? A compatible coating may be applied over a suitable film. Confirm compatibility with both product manufacturers, including any effect on finish, care and warranty terms. DIGI-TEC can discuss combined options for compatible surfaces. Does PPF change the appearance of the paint? Clear paint protection film is intended to preserve the appearance of the underlying paint, although its texture, edges and joins may be visible. Ask DIGI-TEC to confirm the available product and finish, show a sample and explain the expected result before choosing. How long does PPF installation take? Timing depends on coverage, vehicle shape, paint preparation and the chosen installation method. Ask for the expected workshop time and any aftercare or settling period when the team confirms your car’s scope. Existing-film removal or replacement is a separate enquiry: confirm availability, paint condition, risks and scope before booking. How should PPF be maintained? Follow the selected film manufacturer’s care instructions, including the first-wash interval and approved cleaning products. Remove dirt gently, avoid abrasive polishing and keep pressure-washer jets away from film edges. For bubbles, lifting edges, staining or damage, record the installation date and send photos. Settling, contamination, adhesion and physical damage need different assessments. Do not puncture, pull or heat the film yourself. Ask for inspection rather than assuming the film can be repaired or must be replaced. Water spots and contaminants can still mark the finish. ▸ Ceramic coating: does not stop stone chips, and should not be sold as though it does. ▸ Both: require suitable paint preparation and ongoing care; neither repairs existing paint defects. Why Dubai conditions matter Sun exposure, fine dust and dried water deposits make regular paint care relevant in Dubai. Wiping dusty paint dry can leave fine scratches, and water spotting still needs attention on protected paint. Coating can help with cleaning, while film provides a physical barrier on covered panels. Environmental performance depends on the selected product, and neither replaces careful washing. How to choose ▸ Frequent highway driving: consider film on exposed panels and choose coverage around the vehicle and budget. ▸ Low-mileage collection car: consider whether coating would support the desired appearance and care routine. ▸ New car: inspect the finish first, then compare full-body, front or selected-panel film and suitable coating options. ▸ Older paint: assess the condition before protection; correction is useful only where suitable defects and safe limits justify it. Preparation Comes Before Protection If swirls, haze or scratches are already visible, assess the paint before deciding which protection to apply. Polishing or correction may improve suitable defects, but it does not add long-term protective coverage by itself. Deep damage or failed clear coat may require a different repair. Agree the preparation separately from the film or coating scope. Ask for product-specific maintenance instructions and any written warranty terms; no single lifespan applies to every film or coating. Can PPF and ceramic coating be combined? A suitable coating can create a water-repellent surface, enhance the appearance of prepared paint and help with routine cleaning. Benefits depend on the product, preparation, application and care. acceptedAnswer.text: لا يجعل الطلاء مقاوماً لكل خدش، ولا يقدم حاجزاً مادياً مثل PPF. يظل الغسيل اللطيف وإزالة الأوساخ بالطريقة المناسبة ضروريين.

mainEntity.name: هل يمكن وضع السيراميك فوق PPF؟

acceptedAnswer.text: يمكن مناقشة الجمع بينهما عند توافق الفيلم والطلاء والأسطح. تُؤكد متطلبات المنتجين وترتيب التطبيق والعناية قبل الموافقة، ولا يُفترض توافق جميع المنتجات.
اتبع تعليمات التسليم والمنتج المحدد بشأن التجفيف وأول غسيل والمواد المناسبة. لا تفترض فترة واحدة لجميع الطلاءات، وناقش أي تغير في السطح قبل طلب إعادة التطبيق.
